messages:
Ana: Heads-up — drafting a short playbook for 'Analyst query timebox + escalation' for SIEM exports and JIT-unwrapped log access. Want feedback before I turn into a policy PR. Key goals: limit blast radius for ad-hoc exports, ensure KMS unwrap is auditable, and have clear incident escalation if export looks suspicious.

Ana: Draft ticket/template I'm proposing (copyable):
```
Requestor: <name>
Purpose: <investigation|forensics|third-party>
Query window: <start> to <end>
Scope: <indices/services>
Retention of extract: <hours> (max 72h)
KMS unwrap TTL: <seconds> (max 3600)
Justification link: <case/ticket>
Approver: <sec lead / oncall>
```

Ana: Proposed mechanics: 1) export endpoint enforces `max_extract_ttl=72h` and strips PII by default; 2) KMS unwrap requires one-time JIT token issued by approvals service; 3) audit event written to SIEM + immutable archive for 90 days.

Mike: :eyes: overall 👍. Two qs: how are we mapping RBAC for cross-tenant queries? need role that says "can request export" vs "can approve export". Also insist on `justification` being a required header captured in logs.

Jeff: For SRE: can we auto-snapshot the raw stream to a locked bucket (read-only) for 7 days whenever a JIT unwrap happens? helps incident triage. Also watch out for cross-region egress billing if exports cross regions.

Lina: Compliance note — 90d immutable audit is ok for operational logs, but auth / access logs should keep 180d. If we carve by type, we need clear policy mapping. Also require approver to be a human for >24h extracts.

Samir: From IR playbook POV: add an auto-escalation: if export contains >X unique user IDs or >Y admin events, escalate to sec-oncall within 15m. We should include checksum/hash of exported file written to audit log so we can verify tamper.

Mike: +1 to checksum. Also recommend adding a small snippet for KMS unwrap command in runbook: `kms-cli unwrap --token $JIT_TOKEN --object export-key --ttl 3600` and log stdout to audit service only (no local copies).

Ana: Good catches. I'll add RBAC matrix and thresholds. Quick Q: acceptable default extract TTL? I was thinking 24h default, up to 72h with approver.

Lina: 24h default is fine for most, approve up to 72h for forensics with justification. Document the exception process.

Jeff: I'll prototype the auto-snapshot hook and cost estimate. FYI DeployBot: will need a small feature flag to gate rollout.

DeployBot: ci/cd check — feature-flagging infra changes required: `feature/sie-exports-timebox` failing lint in infra-config. See pipeline: https://ci.redwood.example/pipe/8821

Ana: I'll open a PR with changes + template and the RBAC matrix, pinging everyone for final review. Thanks — will include Samir's escalation thresholds and Mike's header capture as required fields. :thumbsup:
